pinned_body:
variables = Card[:all, :style]&.joined_items_content return unless variables.present? # happens during card:seed:build SassC::Engine.new([variables.strip, content].join("\n")).render rescue SassC::SyntaxError => e match = e.message.match(/line (\d+)/) message = if match offset = 6 corrected_line = match[1].to_i - variables.lines.count + offset e.message .sub(/line \d+:(\d+) of stdin/, "line #{corrected_line}:\\1") .sub(/>>.*$/, ">> #{content.lines[corrected_line - 1]}") # e.message else e.message end errors.add(:content, "
#{message}
".html_safe)

pinned_body_lines.text: return unless variables.present? # happens during card:seed:build

notes: the pinned gemset carries no sassc, so the ENGINE is a stand-in: it raises the error class the body's own rescue names (SassC::SyntaxError), and the capture records how the body corrects the line number and adds the message. The body itself is the gem's own bytes
double_rule: every collaborator RECORDS; an answer the spec did not supply is the recording double's own answer, and the capture names the answers the spec supplied

scenarios.scenario: an scss the engine refuses: the body corrects the line number against the variables and adds the message
